identityContract.environmentFingerprint: Controller-generated SHA-256 digest over normalized dedicated target identity; raw project identifiers and URLs remain outside Git and evidence.
identityContract.expectedRelease: The exact full Git commit supplied at execution must equal the checked-out commit and every deployment/evidence release identity.
identityContract.migrationChain: Repository migrations are ordered by canonical filename and bound by a SHA-256 digest of each normalized migration content digest.
identityContract.hostedEvidence: Evidence identities bind environment fingerprint, exact release, migration digest/tip, deployment/run/result identities and sanitized acceptance results.
identityContract.preflightToken: A single-use HMAC token binds release, environment fingerprint, sanitized inventory digest and canonical migration chain before mutation. Re-inventory and reauthorize after any mismatch or state change.

dataBoundary: No customer data or external real-user data is authorized. Use synthetic or owner-controlled test data only.
providerBoundary: Use deterministic simulated adapters only. Real provider endpoints and calls are prohibited.
deploymentBoundary: A controller-linked hosted non-production pilot may be deployed and tested. Production DNS and cutover remain prohibited.

knownDiscovery.reason: Read-only discovery showed the existing project named Avalaos-core-dev contains MockMate schema/data and must not be repurposed.
